conversion: Owner's icon pack, 4 Nov 2026: 4-older-macOS/default. The .icns and the 1024 px source are copied unchanged.
scope: Assets.car carries the light and dark icon, which macOS picks through CFBundleIconName. AppIcon.icns is the light tile, for readers that only take an .icns.

catalog.conversion: xcrun actool AppIcon.icon --compile . --platform macosx --minimum-deployment-target 14.2 --target-device mac --app-icon AppIcon --standalone-icon-behavior all
catalog.note: sourceSha256 covers icon.json and every layer, each as path, NUL, bytes, in sorted order. outputSha256 pins the committed file: actool writes new UUIDs on every run, so a rebuild has a different hash.
